title: Browser network mediation and real navigation
objective: Bind Quntal's closed browser destination/page/navigation policy to the live isolated engine while preventing Chromium from becoming an unbounded network client. All top-level and subresource traffic must remain inside Quntal destination/egress policy with typed page generations, fresh top-level navigation approval, redirect and DNS-rebinding defenses, and deterministic failure semantics.

include: real page loading for the existing isolated browser profile and typed page identity

top-level navigation preserving destination validation, public-address policy, exact origin binding, DNS re-resolution, hop-by-hop redirect checks, fresh SOFT approval, and page-generation transition semantics
browser-request mediation for document, iframe, script, style, image, font, fetch/XHR, worker/service-worker, WebSocket, and other network-capable resource classes

explicit denial or mediation of QUIC, DoH, WebRTC direct-network bypass, proxy bypass, private/loopback/link-local/metadata destinations, unsafe schemes, external protocol handlers, browser-internal URLs, and userinfo destinations
bounded redirects, requests, response headers/body metadata used for policy, tab/page counts, navigation timeouts, and cancellation
automatic download initiation intercepted so SG-000078 remains the only transfer authority
tests for DNS rebinding, redirect widening/downgrade/loops, popup/new-window navigation, iframe escape, service-worker persistence, WebSocket reach, and browser permission prompts

authority_delta.process: No process authority beyond SG-000074 supervised browser processes.
authority_delta.network: The isolated browser may load policy-authorized public web resources only through Quntal-mediated browser egress. Generic socket/proxy/tunnel authority remains absent.
authority_delta.browser: Real page loading/navigation is newly live under existing typed page/origin/approval policy.
authority_delta.secrets: No personal cookies/credentials/session stores are introduced.
authority_delta.approval: Top-level navigation retains fresh SOFT approval with exact destination/page binding; subresources cannot widen authority beyond the approved navigation policy.

invariants: Chromium cannot bypass Quntal destination policy through an alternate network path
top-level navigation remains origin/address/redirect bound and approval gated
automatic download does not become a filesystem write
unsafe/private destinations fail closed before useful content is delivered

acceptance.claim: Real navigation loads an approved public HTTPS destination and binds the resulting live page to the existing page/origin/generation contract.
Tests prove DNS rebinding, redirect widening/downgrade/loops, private/loopback/link-local/metadata targets, unsafe schemes, external protocol handlers, and direct-network bypass classes fail closed.
Iframe, worker/service-worker, fetch/XHR, WebSocket, popup/new-window, and other subresource paths cannot exceed the top-level Quntal destination/egress ceiling.
No DOM/AX caller exposure, actuation, transfer, screenshot exposure, arbitrary JS/CDP, personal profile, or remote reach is introduced.
Exact-head live-browser tests, CI, TypeSafe Jev, Alibaba Open Code Review, security review, and zero unresolved blockers pass.

successor_requirements.sg_000076: Live DOM/accessibility observation may activate only after real navigation and browser egress are qualified.

done_when: Real browser navigation is canonically live through Quntal-mediated egress with bypass, redirect, DNS, download-trigger, and permission escape tests passing.
